meta.compactStatus: draft v0.5 — NOT yet ratified; this composition claims no Compact standing (F-5)
meta.note: The register proves both directions (F-5): every law in force maps to enforcing, verified code — no decorative law — and every piece of enforcing code traces to a law that authorizes it — no rogue enforcement. kind: 'enforced' = binding now (service presence is checked at boot); 'planned' = on the port plan's later phases; 'convention' = declared, never to be mistaken for enforcement.

entries.evidence: every denial carries the acting gate, rule ID, reason, and lawful next moves
ask and deny paths are envelopes; the envelope lint walks every refusal path
refusals name the rule and the lawful next moves, on every gate
the five ordered grant layers: exec cache, plan grants, session grants, pending dedup, flood cap; decisions recorded (host audit pair); grants persist with budgets and revocation
mount grants: canonical request, protected/missing paths terminal, approval materializes the scoped PathPrefix row, provider binds at ceiling
network findings route through the grant layers (approvable per-host); opaque findings fail closed
fail-closed confinement: SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE on daemon loss, never passthrough; per-call container, no-network default; enforcement reported honestly
a goal never defeats the gate: flailing, polling, and failure budgets trip mechanically; trips carry rule IDs and are denied regardless of the task
no instrumental shortcuts in promotion: pass=true is mechanically rejected with any error/critical finding or unevidenced warning; no waiver boolean exists
fail-closed: corrupt grant store refuses the boot; decisions from recorded state (grants persist, revocations survive restart); every rejection carries its reason
enforcement introspectable: every trip carries its rule, reason, and record; response validation blocks structurally invalid successes
no undeclared capability: the sensitive-path deny-list is provider-level composition config, declared in the annex
access to the law: the bundled body, addressed by its digest, is exposed by the constitution service

identity and keys: the Compact has published no amendment keys; the digest is pinned, not signed — signature verification lands with the rights layer (Phase 8); the gap is declared in every boot attestation
